items.headline: Albemarle has surprising new reason to rally
items.snippet: Battery storage demand adds a second lithium demand leg; Mizuho raised 2027 lithium demand ~10%; Q2 realized lithium price $19.53/kg, +61%.

items.headline: Rocket Thrusters on a Road Car Arrive as EV Makers Split Into Winners and Laggards
items.snippet: On Oct 12 GFEX lithium carbonate fell 11.8% to 104,740 yuan/t, ~10-month low; ALB -4.2% pre-market. Q3 results Nov 4.

items.headline: Albemarle upgraded to Outperform from Neutral at Mizuho
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded Albemarle to Outperform from Neutral with an unchanged $130 price target. Strong BESS demand has tipped the market balance into favorable territory.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered PT to $135 from $230, keeps Buy. Lithium up ~67% YoY but below highs; supply/demand poised to improve into 2027.

items.headline: Albemarle Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Management: tight lithium market, demand ahead of supply; maintained 2026 outlook, expects high end of scenario ranges.
